service_name_en: New Voter and National ID Registration
eligibility: Age 10+ for NID application pathway; voter roll inclusion if age ≥18 as of 1 January of the year (per FAQ)

requirements.name_en: Printed copy of online registration form
Passport / Driving licence / TIN (age proof alternative)
Utility bill / house rent receipt / holding tax receipt (address proof)
requirements.name_bn: ইউটিলিটি বিল/বাড়ী ভাড়ার রশিদ/হোল্ডিং ট্যাক্স রশিদ
requirements.notes: FAQ lists as proof of habitual residence in the area.

requirements.name_bn: বাবা, মা, স্বামী/স্ত্রীর এনআইডি কার্ডের কপি

fees.description: Forms for applications — FAQ states forms themselves have no charge
fees.notes: FAQ Q18: forms have no fee. Card issuance fee schedule not confirmed on Tier-1 page in this pass.

processing_time.notes: Official FAQ does not state a fixed processing duration for new registration.

procedure_steps.title: Fill online registration form
procedure_steps.description: Complete personal, other, and address steps in Bangla Unicode (except own full name field rules per FAQ).

procedure_steps.title: Preview and print PDF
procedure_steps.description: Verify all information, generate PDF, print.

procedure_steps.title: Submit at election office with documents
procedure_steps.description: Submit printed form and supporting documents at nearest election office.

procedure_steps.title: Biometric capture
procedure_steps.description: Provide biometrics as scheduled at Upazila/Thana election office.

procedure_steps.title: Receive notification and collect/download card
procedure_steps.description: After processing, receive SMS/email; register online account and download/collect card.

dependencies: Birth registration often used as age proof when SSC unavailable

practical_experience.text: News reporting describes long backlogs and middlemen for NID processes generally; not specific official guidance for new registration.

warnings: Do not apply again if already registered — punishable offence (official FAQ).
False information may lead to imprisonment and/or fine (official FAQ).

claims.claim: Citizens aged 10 years or more who are not yet registered as voters may apply online and provide biometrics at the relevant Upazila/Thana election office.
claims.evidence_excerpt: আপনার বয়স যদি ১০ বছর বা বেশি হয়ে থাকে কিন্তু এখনও ভোটার হিসেবে নিবন্ধিত হননি

claims.claim: If age is 18 years on or before 1 January of the current year, the applicant will be included in the voter list.
claims.evidence_excerpt: আপনার বয়স যদি চলতি বছরের ১ জানুয়ারী বা তার পূর্বে ১৮ বছর হয়ে থাকে

claims.claim: At biometric appointment, applicants need printed online form, age-proof document(s), address proof, and other supporting IDs as applicable.
Re-applying when already registered is a punishable offence.
claims.evidence_excerpt: নিবন্ধিত ব্যাক্তি পুনরায় আবেদন করলে সেটি দন্ডনীয় অপরাধ

claims.claim: For name/age, SSC or equivalent certificate gets priority when the person is SSC-qualified.
claims.evidence_excerpt: এসএসসি অথবা সমমানের পরীক্ষার সনদে উল্লেখিত বয়স ও নাম

missing_information: Exact new-registration card fee amount not published as a static table on retrieved Tier-1 pages (fee calculator covers correction/reissue types).
Exact biometric appointment booking URL/workflow details beyond FAQ summary.
District-wise office hours beyond national helpline hours.
manual_review_required: Confirm whether any fee applies for first-time NID issuance vs correction/reissue only.

knowledge_quality.notes: Strong Tier-1 FAQ coverage for eligibility/docs/steps; fee amount for first issuance incomplete.
